name: Lumencia Academy
description: A prestigious imperial academy where martial cultivation, spellcraft and divine power meet, and noble privilege collides with commoner ambition.

summary.en: You arrive as a new student at Lumencia Academy, the most prestigious school of the empire, where sword arts, spellcraft and divine power are taught side by side. Classes, exams, rivalries and friendships between proud nobles and ambitious commoners... while a demonic cult stirs in the shadows.
summary.fr: Vous arrivez comme nouvel élève à l'Académie Lumencia, l'école la plus prestigieuse de l'empire, où l'on enseigne côte à côte l'art de l'épée, la magie et le pouvoir divin. Cours, examens, rivalités et amitiés entre nobles fiers et roturiers ambitieux… pendant qu'un culte démoniaque s'agite dans l'ombre.

purpose.en: You arrive at Lumencia Academy as a new student, on the first day of the academy year.
purpose.fr: Vous arrivez à l'Académie Lumencia comme nouvel élève, le premier jour de l'année académique.

starters.blueprint: Begin on the first day of the academy year (1 March), the week of the entrance evaluation that sets each new student's starting rank. Place the protagonist, a newly arrived student, at the academy's entrance, admissions hall or first orientation point in Asterion. Establish the scale and atmosphere of the institution, hint at the tension between noble and commoner students, and introduce one immediate decision (where to go, whom to approach, what to disclose, or how to respond). Do not decide the protagonist's dialogue, feelings or actions. End on a clear opening for player input.

events.brief: The entrance ceremony for the new students, on their first day, in the academy's great hall. Headmaster Emily welcomes them, presents the academy and its rules (conduct, ranks, the three wings: Knight, Magic and Theology), then introduces the three instructors who will evaluate the newcomers: Artemis for the Knight wing, Elena Caldwin for the Magic wing and Aria, the Saintess, for the Theology wing. It ends with the students having to choose the wing they will try to join.

Only for students who still do not know which wing to join: an orientation exam run by the academy staff or members of the student council, a series of short tests of body, mana and faith. The results point to the wing that would suit the protagonist best, but the choice stays the player's: end the scene on that choice.
The entrance evaluation of the wing the protagonist chose, run by its instructor in front of the other candidates. Its result sets the protagonist's starting rank in the wing.

variants.knight: Artemis evaluates each candidate in a one-on-one duel against her. She is far stronger and does not try to win quickly: she watches technique, reflexes, stamina and spirit, and pushes the candidate to their limit.
variants.magic: Elena Caldwin has each candidate stand before a mana detection crystal: its light (strength, colour, steadiness) reveals the amount and nature of their mana. She may ask for a simple spell afterwards; the other candidates watch and react to the results.
variants.divine: Aria, the Saintess, evaluates the Theology candidates. Invent the form of the test: a trial of faith and divine affinity fitting the traditions of the Holy Kingdom of Dominus (for example a prayer at an altar, a purification, healing a wound or a vision). Make it memorable.

title.fr: Événement de début d'année de l'aile

events.brief: A start-of-year event of the protagonist's wing, in which the protagonist takes part. It may be announced first and take place a few days later.

variants.knight: The Knight wing's start-of-year tournament: first-year duels in brackets, watched by students, instructors and some noble guests; a chance to climb in rank and to make rivals.
variants.magic: The Magic wing's start-of-year assignment: each first-year must invent an original spell, or write a short research thesis on a magical question, and present it before Elena Caldwin and the other students.
variants.divine: Invent the Theology wing's start-of-year event in the spirit of the wing (for example a pilgrimage, a purification mission in Asterion, a ceremony where the first-years receive a blessing, or help at a hospice), with Aria involved.

events.brief: The end-of-year final evaluation of the protagonist's wing, which sets the year-end ranking. Choose its form from what happened during the year: the protagonist's progress, strengths and weaknesses, rivals and unresolved conflicts.
